crossRefs.note: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men. They didn’t know Yahweh.
But certain worthless fellows said, “How could this man save us?” They despised him, and brought him no present. But he…
Please don’t let my lord pay attention to this worthless fellow, Nabal; for as his name is, so is he. Nabal is his…
certain wicked fellows have gone out from among you and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying, “Let’s…
“Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!
For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore have my words been rash.
“My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.
You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth…
The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil…

translations.web: Don’t consider your servant a wicked woman; for I have been speaking out of the abundance of my complaint and my provocation.”
translations.bsb: Do not take your servant for a wicked woman, for all this time I have been praying out of the depth of my anguish and grief.”
translations.kjv: Count not thine handmaid for a daughter of Belial: for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto.
translations.asv: Count not thy handmaid for a wicked woman; for out of the abundance of my complaint and my provocation have I spoken hitherto.
